name: Stormbringer: Stormcloud amplifies damage and erupts a Geyser (#3235)
contract: #3235: Stormcloud 801859 reads "Summon a cloud above an enemy target's head for $d, causing them to take $s1% additional damage from your spells. Using Torrential Wrath on an enemy affected by Stormcloud causes a Geyser to erupt beneath them." Spell.dbc gives 801859 DurationIndex 8 (SpellDuration.dbc 8 = 15000 ms), RecoveryTime 60000, effect 0 aura 271 SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_FROM_CASTER with EffectBasePoints 19 and DieSides 1 (= 20%) and an all-zero SpellClassMask. The first clause is native and the report's premise is wrong: SpellAuraEffects.cpp:336 routes aura 271 through Unit::SpellDamageBonusTaken (Unit.cpp:9440-9445), which matches on the aura's own caster and on AuraEffect::IsAffectedOnSpell; SpellInfo::IsAffected (SpellInfo.cpp:1437) returns true for a zero class mask inside the same family, so the 20% covers every SpellFamilyName 22 spell from that Stormbringer. spell_damage_taken queries that path with a fixed base of 1000, so the readings are exactly 1000 unamplified and 1200 amplified. The second clause had no path at all: Geyser 800374 is family 32 and the only spell in Spell.dbc that triggers it is 706593, which is not a Stormbringer spell, and no spell_script_names, spell_linked_spell or conditions row names 801859 or 800374. The fix casts 800374 on a target that carries this Stormbringer's Stormcloud when any Torrential Wrath rank lands on it. Torrential Wrath is cast as rank 503359, the rank a level-80 character owns (AscensionTalentReplacementData.h:41-42 gives it RequiredLevel 58).

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
BASELINE: without Stormcloud the target takes the unmodified base of 1000
BASELINE: no Geyser has been cast
NATIVE: Stormcloud is applied by this Stormbringer
NATIVE: aura 271 adds the tooltip's 20% (BasePoints 19 + DieSides 1), so 1000 becomes 1200
SETUP: Torrential Wrath lands on the Stormcloud'd target
DISCRIMINATING: Torrential Wrath erupts one Geyser (800374)
